name: nf-payg-withholding
description: Apply selected Norfolk Island PAYG withholding, registration and reporting rules for payments from July 2026. Separates employee withholding from territorial supplier ABN exceptions, declaration status, ordinary recurring pay coefficients, no-TFN rates, remittance cycles and STP finalisation. Use for Norfolk salary withholding, PAYG, employee declarations, payroll reporting or payment-summary questions. Includes primary legislation, period conversion, statutory rounding, fictional component examples and reviewer checks. Keeps super separate from employee deductions and preserves unresolved special payments, employment standards and payroll country slots. This source-cited reference does not complete a payslip, filing calendar, payroll engagement or country pack.
